title: Desktop-TU: Terminal-First Desktop Environment Written in Rust
description:
🚀 Desktop-TUI – a tiling desktop environment without graphics.
Launch apps, resize/move windows, handle crashes… all inside your terminal.
Written in Rust, MIT-licensed.
Try it if you love tmux-style minimalism! 

👉https://github.com/Julien-cpsn/desktop-tui
